a321069086bc.en: Her sense of pleasure still coursed through her face as she grabbed a scalpel and approached Harry. She held him by the throat with one hand while the other ran the scalpel down his chest, making a thin superficial cut. “Do you feel this?” Eori asked, looking at the blood pooling on his chest wound, releasing the grip on his neck.
a321069086bc.t: Rasa kenikmatannya masih mengalir di wajahnya saat ia mengambil pisau bedah dan mendekati Harry. Ia memegang tenggorokannya dengan satu tangan sementara tangan yang lain menggoreskan pisau bedah ke bawah dadanya, membuat sayatan tipis di permukaan. “Kau merasakan ini?” tanya Eori, memandang darah yang menggenang di luka dadanya, melepaskan cengkeraman di lehernya.

aafa4892247d.en: “Like this.” Eori clenched her right hand but left her middle and ring fingers out flat—as if she were flipping the bird. A bluish fire emerged and waved back and forth excitedly to become whatever its master demanded. She then fed the spell into the other hand, making roughly a ball of marble-sized water appear on the smallest ring and spin around like it was trying to escape. “Now, do it too.”
aafa4892247d.t: “Begini.” Eori mengepalkan tangan kanannya tetapi membiarkan jari tengah dan jari manisnya terentang datar—seolah sedang mengacungkan jari tengah. Api kebiruan muncul dan meliuk maju mundur dengan bersemangat untuk menjadi apa pun yang dituntut tuannya. Ia lalu mengumpankan mantra itu ke tangan yang lain, membuat bola air kira-kira seukuran kelereng muncul di cincin terkecil dan berputar seolah berusaha kabur. “Sekarang, lakukan juga.”

ab920d09458d.en: Eori stroked Harry’s eyebrow, then hers, perhaps measuring density. She then looked at her hairless chest, arms, and legs. Raising Harry’s arms without asking, she carefully analyzed his armpit hair against hers. “Something is off. I will investigate more after dinner.” Eori kept on shaving Harry. “Your neck beard is shit, just like the fat pricks from Tolerideme.”
ab920d09458d.t: Eori mengusap alis Harry, lalu alisnya sendiri, mungkin mengukur ketebalannya. Ia lalu memandang dada, lengan, dan kakinya yang tidak berbulu. Mengangkat lengan Harry tanpa bertanya, ia dengan cermat menganalisis bulu ketiak Harry dibandingkan miliknya. “Ada yang tidak beres. Akan kuselidiki lebih jauh setelah makan malam.” Eori terus mencukur Harry. “Janggut lehermu payah, persis seperti bajingan-bajingan gemuk dari Tolerideme.”

addaa2117e68.en: Looking around this unfamiliar room, Harry’s eyes couldn’t see any details due to the blurriness of his vision, but he could mentally assume a few things. There was a writing desk to his left, a grinder in the corner, and a plethora of metallic pointy things shining on top of another table between the grinder and jars of macabre stuff stacked in the wall of the other corner. The grinder had the same bluish hues as the one he had seen on the ground floor of the Sanbi castle’s southwest tower. Same for the wall of macabre stuff, but this time it was even more festive in colors, with the jars in the bottom rows being on the redder spectrum, holding who-knows-what inside, while the jars in the upper rows banded in different hues from cyan, magenta, yellow, to black and artful mixes of them. Looking at the table in front of him, he saw a well-illuminated fost lamp as the only light source in the room, and by it, four mixing bowls all looking reddish with some stuff inside he couldn’t quite see. Inside each mixing bowl was something metallic and girthy. Three of these metallic girthy things were filled with the same reddish concoction.
addaa2117e68.t: Memandang sekeliling ruangan yang asing ini, mata Harry tidak bisa melihat detail apa pun karena penglihatannya yang buram, tetapi ia bisa menduga beberapa hal dalam pikirannya. Ada meja tulis di sebelah kirinya, alat penggiling di sudut, dan banyak sekali benda logam runcing yang berkilauan di atas meja lain di antara alat penggiling dan toples-toples berisi barang mengerikan yang ditumpuk di dinding di sudut lainnya. Alat penggiling itu punya rona kebiruan yang sama seperti yang pernah ia lihat di lantai dasar southwest tower kastil Sanbi. Begitu juga dinding berisi barang-barang mengerikan itu, tetapi kali ini warnanya bahkan lebih meriah, dengan toples-toples di baris bawah berada di spektrum yang lebih merah, berisi entah apa di dalamnya, sementara toples-toples di baris atas berjajar dalam rona yang berbeda-beda dari sian, magenta, kuning, sampai hitam dan campuran artistik di antaranya. Memandang meja di depannya, ia melihat lampu fost yang terang benderang sebagai satu-satunya sumber cahaya di ruangan itu, dan di sampingnya, empat mangkuk adonan yang semuanya tampak kemerahan dengan sesuatu di dalamnya yang tidak bisa ia lihat dengan jelas. Di dalam setiap mangkuk adonan ada sesuatu yang logam dan tebal. Tiga dari benda logam tebal ini terisi ramuan kemerahan yang sama.

ae0cdf221e9b.en: Eori threw the empty mug on the wall across from Harry, making a loud bang that sounded like a shotgun had gone off. “FUCK OFF! YOU’RE THE ONE WHO’S SUPPOSED TO MAKE THIS SHIT EASIER! I’m not getting any results, and now I have to fucking babysit you too!” She then took what appeared to be a salt shaker and shook it into the fost lamp, bringing it back to life and brightening up the room. “Don’t you fucking dare!” With a sneer plastered on her face, she slumped forward by Harry and picked up the wooden bucket that smelled strongly of piss. With a large groan, she strained her face and lifted the bucket towards the sink. Removing the stopper from the sink, she dumped the piss down the drain and doused vinegar into both to curb the piss stench. Placing the empty bucket back where it was, she added the end tube of Harry’s pee cup back into it. “Don’t you fucking dare shit on me again!”
ae0cdf221e9b.t: Eori melempar gelas kosong itu ke dinding di seberang Harry, menimbulkan dentuman keras yang terdengar seperti tembakan senapan. “PERSETAN! KAU YANG SEHARUSNYA MEMBUAT URUSAN SIALAN INI LEBIH MUDAH! Aku tidak mendapat hasil apa pun, dan sekarang aku harus mengasuhmu juga, bangsat!” Ia lalu mengambil sesuatu yang tampak seperti tempat garam dan mengguncangkannya ke lampu fost, menyalakannya kembali dan menerangi ruangan. “Jangan berani-berani, bangsat!” Dengan cibiran tercoreng di wajahnya, ia membungkuk di dekat Harry dan mengangkat ember kayu yang berbau tajam air kencing. Dengan erangan besar, ia menegangkan wajahnya dan mengangkat ember itu ke arah wastafel. Melepas sumbat wastafel, ia membuang air kencing itu ke saluran pembuangan dan menuangkan cuka ke keduanya untuk meredam bau pesingnya. Menaruh ember kosong itu kembali di tempatnya, ia memasang kembali ujung selang cawan kencing Harry ke dalamnya. “Jangan berani-berani berak di depanku lagi, bangsat!”

b01916843d0c.en: Harry closed his eyes and curled up his body as the memories of what had happened poured in. His heart began racing so loudly, he could feel it pounding on the back of his head like he had a migraine. In the darkness of his vision, he could feel glimpses of being in a dark forest, running away from those same exact noises. The imminence of death and despair played with his heart as he could nearly feel an arrow stuck in his trachea while the warm blood poured down his throat, warming his chest as if he had a warm, cozy blanket resting on him. He gasped as he opened his eyes, trying to escape that feeling. He saw Eori putting the bow away, and with short, shallow breaths, he looked down at his own body. The arrow was snapped in pieces, lying on the floor to his left—probably after hitting the same hard wall Harry was chained to.
b01916843d0c.t: Harry memejamkan matanya dan meringkukkan tubuhnya saat ingatan-ingatan tentang apa yang telah terjadi membanjir masuk. Jantungnya mulai berpacu begitu keras, ia bisa merasakannya berdebam di bagian belakang kepalanya seolah ia terkena migrain. Dalam kegelapan penglihatannya, ia bisa merasakan kilasan-kilasan berada di hutan yang gelap, lari dari bunyi-bunyi yang persis sama itu. Dekatnya kematian dan keputusasaan mempermainkan hatinya karena ia hampir bisa merasakan anak panah menancap di batang tenggorokannya sementara darah hangat mengalir di kerongkongannya, menghangatkan dadanya seolah ada selimut hangat yang nyaman di atasnya. Ia tersentak saat membuka matanya, berusaha kabur dari perasaan itu. Ia melihat Eori menyimpan busurnya, dan dengan napas pendek dan dangkal, ia menunduk melihat tubuhnya sendiri. Anak panah itu patah berkeping-keping, tergeletak di lantai di sebelah kirinya—mungkin setelah menghantam dinding keras yang sama tempat Harry dirantai.

b1b1ac8506da.en: “Open your mouth!” Eori said as she shoved a hefty dose of black honey down his gullet, nearly feeding him the same way farmers do to geese to fatten them up for some deliciously buttery rich foie gras.
b1b1ac8506da.t: “Buka mulutmu!” kata Eori sambil menjejalkan madu hitam dalam dosis besar ke kerongkongannya, hampir memberinya makan dengan cara yang sama seperti peternak memberi makan angsa untuk menggemukkannya demi foie gras yang lezat dan kaya mentega.

b25266a88bfe.en: A mixture of gag, cough, and breath all kept trying to happen simultaneously, but there was only one pipe to share all of those actions—a classical race condition. Despite wanting to breathe, Harry felt like his only action was to hold in the urge to breathe and swallow this diabetes-inducing sloppy grainy, thick paste with a big forceful gulp.
b25266a88bfe.t: Campuran mual, batuk, dan napas semuanya terus berusaha terjadi bersamaan, tetapi hanya ada satu saluran untuk berbagi semua tindakan itu—kondisi balapan klasik. Meski ingin bernapas, Harry merasa satu-satunya tindakannya adalah menahan dorongan untuk bernapas dan menelan pasta kental berpasir yang lembek dan bikin diabetes ini dengan satu tegukan besar yang dipaksakan.

b2e86b191495.en: “What else? What’s the last thing you remember?” Eori’s interviewer mood kicked into high gear again.
b2e86b191495.t: “Apa lagi? Apa hal terakhir yang kau ingat?” Suasana hati Eori sebagai pewawancara kembali bergigi tinggi.

b32df4dcae08.en: Eori ignored his feet kicking her thigh and crotch, at least at first. “Fucking stop it!” The more Harry struggled, the more her smile disappeared, leaving behind eyes seething with acute anger. She squeezed Harry’s neck with all her revengeful might, now truly squeezing his life out. She shook it violently, screaming in his face, “ANSWER THE FUCKING QUESTION!”
b32df4dcae08.t: Eori mengabaikan kaki Harry yang menendang paha dan selangkangannya, setidaknya pada awalnya. “Berhenti, bangsat!” Semakin Harry meronta, semakin hilang senyumnya, meninggalkan mata yang mendidih dengan amarah yang tajam. Ia meremas leher Harry dengan seluruh kekuatan dendamnya, kini benar-benar meremas habis nyawanya. Ia mengguncangnya dengan keras, berteriak di depan wajahnya, “JAWAB PERTANYAANNYA, BANGSAT!”

b45efbbaa16d.en: With his sphincter tightening up, Harry did all he could to prevent that. Although, not like he had anything on the tank either—a benefit of a diet consisting of nothing but black honey. His eyes were bothered by the brighter light, but he kept on silently trying to follow along with what Eori was doing, now seeing her gruntle as she struggled to remove what appeared to be a barrel from underneath the sink, put a cork on the top hole, then continually scratch it on the floor as she kept pushing it closer to the stairs.
b45efbbaa16d.t: Dengan otot sfingternya mengencang, Harry melakukan segala yang ia bisa untuk mencegah hal itu. Walaupun, bukan berarti ada isinya juga—keuntungan dari pola makan yang hanya terdiri dari madu hitam. Matanya terganggu oleh cahaya yang lebih terang, tetapi ia terus diam-diam mencoba mengikuti apa yang dilakukan Eori, kini melihatnya menggerutu saat bersusah payah mengeluarkan sesuatu yang tampak seperti tong dari bawah wastafel, memasang sumbat di lubang atasnya, lalu terus menyeretnya di lantai sambil mendorongnya semakin dekat ke tangga.

b72d87dbbd5b.en: “Dammit—which variant of thirty-seven I used that day?” Eori spoke under her breath, rapidly flipping through the pages in her girly pink journal.
b72d87dbbd5b.t: “Sialan—varian tiga puluh tujuh yang mana yang kupakai hari itu?” Eori berbicara pelan, cepat-cepat membalik halaman-halaman jurnal merah mudanya yang feminin.

bc46639fd4de.en: From clouding darkness enveloping his senses, Harry felt a touch of a soft palm on his skinless chest. A burning, itchy sensation came into his flayed flesh as his left eye saw Eori unclenching her fingers, scraping her nails in his flesh, firmly holding her palm against his chest.
bc46639fd4de.t: Dari kegelapan yang mengaburkan dan menyelimuti indranya, Harry merasakan sentuhan telapak tangan yang lembut di dadanya yang tak berkulit. Sensasi terbakar dan gatal datang ke dagingnya yang terkuliti saat mata kirinya melihat Eori membuka genggaman jari-jarinya, menggaruk kukunya di daging Harry, menekan telapak tangannya kuat-kuat ke dadanya.

bcd904e115fa.en: A cackle sounded in the room. “How did that feel?” Long-haired Harry placed her girly pajamas in front of her, hiding her manly looking nipples.
bcd904e115fa.t: Tawa terkekeh terdengar di ruangan. “Bagaimana rasanya?” Harry berambut panjang meletakkan piyama femininnya di depannya, menyembunyikan puting yang tampak kelelakian.

bd1ec03f8587.en: Harry repeated after her, but nothing happened—not even doing with the other hand or both hands.
bd1ec03f8587.t: Harry mengulanginya, tetapi tidak terjadi apa-apa—bahkan tidak saat memakai tangan yang lain atau kedua tangan.

bf3f7f732dad.en: Harry felt the long-hair version of himself getting awfully close to him; he could nearly feel and smell her manly bits about to touch his face. He clenched himself even more, waiting for the worst, but then he felt something happening to one of his wrists. A clacking sound followed by his numb left arm falling limp by his side made a sharp pain go up his shoulder. The other arm now held his entire weight, dislocating it from his shoulder. With another clack, his body was released, and he crashed onto the ground like a disembodied ragdoll. A prickling sensation took over his hands, going up to his forearms, while his shoulders and back felt tender and weak.
bf3f7f732dad.t: Harry merasakan versi dirinya yang berambut panjang mendekat sangat dekat; ia hampir bisa merasakan dan mencium bagian kelelakiannya yang akan menyentuh wajahnya. Ia semakin mengencangkan dirinya, menunggu yang terburuk, tetapi kemudian ia merasakan sesuatu terjadi pada salah satu pergelangan tangannya. Bunyi klak disusul lengan kirinya yang mati rasa jatuh terkulai di sisinya membuat rasa sakit tajam naik ke bahunya. Lengan yang lain kini menahan seluruh berat badannya, membuatnya terlepas dari bahunya. Dengan bunyi klak lagi, tubuhnya terlepas, dan ia jatuh menghantam lantai seperti boneka kain tanpa tubuh. Sensasi seperti ditusuk-tusuk jarum mengambil alih tangannya, naik ke lengan bawahnya, sementara bahu dan punggungnya terasa nyeri dan lemah.

c05022504ef2.en: Harry reacted poorly, letting the sigil ring fall on the floor near his feet. Picking it up, he saw a familiar two-finger hole on the back and a large plaque in front, but the logograms on the plaque looked different; one was four stacked horizontally curved lines, while the other was a plus sign. This is not Body Restore—something plus? Wait! Water Create? Harry saw the writing on the back plate. Ohhhh. I get it now. Remembering how Eiri used Body Restore to heal him, he wore the ring on his right middle and ring fingers, then with the same hand, he tried to clench the fingers while leaving the palm exposed. Wait—is that right?
c05022504ef2.t: Harry bereaksi buruk, membiarkan cincin sigil itu jatuh ke lantai di dekat kakinya. Memungutnya, ia melihat lubang dua jari yang familier di bagian belakang dan pelat besar di depan, tetapi logogram di pelat itu tampak berbeda; satu berupa empat garis lengkung horizontal yang bertumpuk, sementara yang lain berupa tanda tambah. Ini bukan Body Restore—sesuatu tambah? Tunggu! Water Create? Harry melihat tulisan di pelat belakang. Ohhhh. Sekarang aku paham. Teringat bagaimana Eiri memakai Body Restore untuk menyembuhkannya, ia memakai cincin itu di jari tengah dan jari manis kanannya, lalu dengan tangan yang sama, ia mencoba mengepalkan jari-jarinya sambil membiarkan telapak tangannya terbuka. Tunggu—apa begitu caranya?

c241043b732d.en: Vol 2 Chapter III subchapter 5: Harry, chained and bearded, looks over at the purple-haired woman working at a cluttered table.
c241043b732d.t: Jilid 2 Bab III subbab 5: Harry, terantai dan berjanggut, memandang ke arah wanita berambut ungu yang bekerja di meja yang berantakan.

c2c39fca6828.en: Harry felt a sinking feeling—perhaps his fate was sealed the moment he awoke in that tower.
c2c39fca6828.t: Harry merasakan perasaan tenggelam—mungkin nasibnya sudah ditentukan saat ia terbangun di menara itu.

c40e1bf655cf.en: Eori jotted down something in the journal, sighing heavily as she softly chewed the winga feather. She seemed lost in thought for a mere moment, at least until she threw the feather on the table and blurted out, “You know what? Fuck it! I give up on thirty-seven.” She waved the journal to let the ink dry, then closed and shoved it on the smaller bookcase hanging on the wall above her.
c40e1bf655cf.t: Eori mencatat sesuatu di jurnal, menghela napas berat sambil mengunyah pelan bulu winga itu. Ia tampak tenggelam dalam pikiran hanya sesaat, setidaknya sampai ia melempar bulu itu ke meja dan menyembur, “Tahu tidak? Persetan! Aku menyerah dengan tiga puluh tujuh.” Ia mengibaskan jurnal itu agar tintanya kering, lalu menutupnya dan menjejalkannya ke rak buku yang lebih kecil yang tergantung di dinding di atasnya.

c42f845c716f.en: After cleaning the basement with Eori, with him doing all the grunt work, she brought him to where he was now. He looked in front of him, towards the slanted walls of an unknown bathroom, on the second floor of a house he had never seen before. In his peripheral vision, he could see manly bits hanging. Looking down at his own, it looked like a clone, as even the right-slant crook was there too. In his lap, his arms rested with pieces of hair and dried blood dirtying his skin, while his wrists were shackled by a robust chain that was tight but not too tight as to hurt him. His feet also suffered the same fate, ensuring he wouldn’t get far if he were to escape. I guess at least I’m no longer hanging from the wall?
c42f845c716f.t: Setelah membersihkan ruang bawah tanah bersama Eori, dengan dia yang mengerjakan semua pekerjaan kasarnya, Eori membawanya ke tempat ia berada sekarang. Ia memandang ke depan, ke arah dinding-dinding miring sebuah kamar mandi yang tidak dikenal, di lantai dua sebuah rumah yang belum pernah ia lihat sebelumnya. Dalam penglihatan tepinya, ia bisa melihat bagian kelelakian yang menggantung. Memandang ke bawah ke miliknya sendiri, tampak seperti kloningan, karena bahkan bengkok miring ke kanannya pun ada. Di pangkuannya, lengannya bersandar dengan potongan rambut dan darah kering mengotori kulitnya, sementara pergelangan tangannya dibelenggu rantai kokoh yang erat tetapi tidak terlalu erat sampai menyakitinya. Kakinya juga mengalami nasib yang sama, memastikan ia tidak akan pergi jauh kalau ia mencoba kabur. Kurasa setidaknya aku tidak lagi tergantung di dinding?

c6a60e5a7699.en: Feeling his mouth violated by a large spoon, Harry’s throat demanded a gag in response.
c6a60e5a7699.t: Merasakan mulutnya dilanggar oleh sendok besar, tenggorokan Harry menuntut muntah sebagai respons.

c6d2d94e6822.en: With another grunt as his inner organs begged for mercy, Harry’s brain went blank as a surging wave of cold sweat hit him, making him look pale. “What—what—do you—want from me?”
c6d2d94e6822.t: Dengan erangan lain saat organ-organ dalamnya memohon belas kasihan, otak Harry kosong saat gelombang keringat dingin menerjangnya, membuatnya tampak pucat. “Apa—apa—yang kau—mau dariku?”

c77d119efa2b.en: Meanwhile, Eori’s hands were full. One hand carried a tantalizing half-bitten sandwich that had red and purple meat contrasting the hearty amount of leafy greens. On the other, it was a mug with a blackish liquid. She finished the sandwich as she approached Harry and lifted the mug towards his mouth.
c77d119efa2b.t: Sementara itu, tangan Eori penuh. Satu tangan membawa sandwich setengah digigit yang menggoda dengan daging merah dan ungu yang kontras dengan sayuran hijau dalam jumlah banyak. Di tangan yang lain, sebuah gelas berisi cairan kehitaman. Ia menghabiskan sandwich itu sambil mendekati Harry dan mengangkat gelas itu ke mulutnya.

c98adf1119e8.en: Harry looked down and had a jerking reaction. Somehow seeing that there wasn’t a massive syringe poking his belly button, and it wasn’t bleeding either, just felt incredibly weird—as if it was still there even though he saw Eori putting the syringe back on the table. His brain jolted again, now telling him his chest was being cut apart even though his eyes saw it had already happened. “Why? Why—” Harry froze with his mouth open for a few seconds. “Eori? Please! I didn’t do anything!” His droopy voice spoke pleadingly, with the scalpel pain kicking in, bothering him like a paper cut.
c98adf1119e8.t: Harry menunduk dan bereaksi tersentak. Entah bagaimana melihat bahwa tidak ada jarum suntik raksasa yang menusuk pusarnya, dan pusarnya juga tidak berdarah, terasa luar biasa aneh—seolah jarum itu masih ada di sana walaupun ia melihat Eori menaruh jarum suntik itu kembali di meja. Otaknya tersentak lagi, kini memberitahunya bahwa dadanya sedang diiris walaupun matanya melihat itu sudah terjadi. “Kenapa? Kenapa—” Harry membeku dengan mulut terbuka selama beberapa detik. “Eori? Tolong! Aku tidak melakukan apa-apa!” Suaranya yang lesu berbicara memohon, dengan rasa sakit pisau bedah mulai terasa, mengganggunya seperti luka teriris kertas.

cacca08b11e8.en: The memory of flesh being scooped out of him came back to mind, and with it, the pain. He remained silent as his body tensed up. Suddenly, Arukia came to his mind. Maybe I am from Tolerideme? She did say I reminded her of them!
cacca08b11e8.t: Ingatan tentang daging yang dikerat dari tubuhnya kembali ke benaknya, dan bersamanya, rasa sakitnya. Ia tetap diam sementara tubuhnya menegang. Tiba-tiba, Arukia muncul di benaknya. Mungkin aku dari Tolerideme? Dia memang bilang aku mengingatkannya pada mereka!

cd17caef109e.en: With an open mouth, Harry could not believe what his eyes were seeing; Eori’s clenched face and fists held back what had to be immense pain. She tilted her head back while her bloodshot eyes looked like someone let hungry rats trample through her insides. Ow fuck—is that? Harry saw Eori transforming into a copy of himself right before his eyes—he couldn’t see every detail of it, but she was undoubtedly turning into himself. The bone-crunching noises coming from her body sounded like a chiro was adjusting every bone at once. The flesh visibly moved beneath her skin as her hair turned black from the follicles in her scalp and down its length. Why is she doing that? Harry nearly felt like he was the one in pain, seeing a near-identical copy of himself reeve in agony—the only difference now being her long black hair.
cd17caef109e.t: Dengan mulut terbuka, Harry tidak bisa memercayai apa yang dilihat matanya; wajah dan kepalan tangan Eori yang mengencang menahan apa yang pasti rasa sakit yang luar biasa. Ia menengadahkan kepalanya ke belakang sementara matanya yang merah tampak seolah seseorang melepaskan tikus-tikus lapar untuk menginjak-injak bagian dalam tubuhnya. Oh bangsat—apa itu? Harry melihat Eori berubah menjadi salinan dirinya tepat di depan matanya—ia tidak bisa melihat setiap detailnya, tetapi Eori jelas sedang berubah menjadi dirinya. Bunyi tulang berderak yang datang dari tubuhnya terdengar seperti seorang chiropractor sedang membetulkan setiap tulang sekaligus. Daging bergerak kentara di bawah kulitnya sementara rambutnya berubah hitam dari folikel di kulit kepalanya dan turun sepanjang helainya. Kenapa dia melakukan itu? Harry hampir merasa seolah dialah yang kesakitan, melihat salinan dirinya yang hampir identik menggeliat dalam penderitaan—satu-satunya perbedaan sekarang adalah rambut hitamnya yang panjang.

cd8a3aff4e4c.en: With his left eye, Harry saw her carefully slice the scoops of his carved flesh as if he had just placed a special order to the butcher, and he was standing there, waiting for it while thinking of what to cook for sides to pair up with his mouthwatering meat. IT HURTS! Harry meandering hyperphantasia of a summer cookout was hindered by what he felt like a rat was let loose inside his right eye socket, trying to scratch its way out. He felt a moistness develop in the area as a sharp, throbbing, shocking pain made him want to shriek like a rageful primate. He felt his lungs filling up and his vocal cords ready to scream until they tore up, but at the last second, his mind held back that urge with another internal guttural scream that half-escaped through his nose. The thought of Eori flipping her shit and making his pain worse was more than enough to force him to contain it all back.
cd8a3aff4e4c.t: Dengan mata kirinya, Harry melihatnya dengan hati-hati mengiris potongan-potongan daging tubuhnya yang dikerat seolah ia baru saja memesan pesanan khusus kepada tukang daging, dan ia berdiri di sana, menunggunya sambil memikirkan lauk pendamping apa yang akan dimasak untuk dipadukan dengan dagingnya yang menggugah selera. SAKIT! Hiperfantasia Harry yang melantur tentang acara barbeku musim panas terhalang oleh apa yang terasa seperti seekor tikus dilepaskan di dalam rongga mata kanannya, berusaha mencakar jalan keluar. Ia merasakan kelembapan muncul di area itu saat rasa sakit yang tajam, berdenyut, dan mengejutkan membuatnya ingin memekik seperti primata yang mengamuk. Ia merasakan paru-parunya terisi dan pita suaranya siap berteriak sampai robek, tetapi di detik terakhir, pikirannya menahan dorongan itu dengan jeritan parau batin lain yang setengah lolos lewat hidungnya. Pikiran tentang Eori yang mengamuk dan membuat rasa sakitnya lebih parah sudah lebih dari cukup untuk memaksanya menahan semuanya kembali.

ce63ed9fdb2c.en: Vol 2 Chapter IV subchapter 1: a long-haired person, seen from behind, shaves the face of a scarred man sitting in an attic room.
ce63ed9fdb2c.t: Jilid 2 Bab IV subbab 1: seseorang berambut panjang, dilihat dari belakang, mencukur wajah seorang pria berbekas luka yang duduk di sebuah ruang loteng.

ceab412767ee.en: Something clicked in Harry’s brain; looking at the nari gel of his own flesh, he said, “Wait—are you selling me? Like—people to look like me?” With a gasp, he continued, raising his voice, “Is this how I am repaying my debt? But—”
ceab412767ee.t: Sesuatu terlintas di otak Harry; memandang nari gel dari dagingnya sendiri, ia berkata, “Tunggu—apa kau menjualku? Maksudnya—supaya orang-orang terlihat seperti aku?” Dengan tarikan napas tertahan, ia melanjutkan, meninggikan suaranya, “Apa begini caraku membayar utangku? Tapi—”

cfaff378d604.en: They are now talking with a fake you. Eori’s voice from before surfaced in Harry’s mind, making a chill run down his bones. “This is for the fake me!”
cfaff378d604.t: Mereka sekarang sedang bicara dengan dirimu yang palsu. Suara Eori dari sebelumnya muncul di benak Harry, membuat hawa dingin menjalari tulang-tulangnya. “Ini untuk aku yang palsu!”

d2224e43e973.en: The same usual feeling of drinking a gallon of coffee rushed in, getting rid of any grogginess—if he was even sleeping before. Harry felt his adrenaline peak, giving his screaming-in-pain wrists a fighting chance to break free from being forced to support his entire body weight. “WHAT? WHAT DID I DO?” The chains in his hand rustled and banged loudly against the wall as he tried to break free. His hanging feet decided to take action and kicked forward with all the strength he could muster—which wasn’t exactly much.
d2224e43e973.t: Perasaan biasa yang sama seperti meminum segalon kopi menerjang masuk, menyingkirkan rasa pening apa pun—kalau ia memang tidur sebelumnya. Harry merasakan adrenalinnya memuncak, memberi pergelangan tangannya yang menjerit kesakitan kesempatan untuk bertarung melepaskan diri dari keharusan menopang seluruh berat badannya. “APA? APA YANG KULAKUKAN?” Rantai di tangannya berkerincing dan membentur dinding dengan keras saat ia mencoba melepaskan diri. Kakinya yang menggantung memutuskan untuk bertindak dan menendang ke depan dengan sekuat tenaga yang bisa ia kerahkan—yang tidak seberapa.

d387de16c4f7.en: “And now?” A scientific glint emerged in Eori’s eyes as the same vicious smile began rising on her face.
d387de16c4f7.t: “Dan sekarang?” Kilau ilmiah muncul di mata Eori sementara senyum keji yang sama mulai muncul di wajahnya.

d46558a6720a.en: “What else?” Eori’s voice sounded feminine, but the probing tone sounded like a yandere girl suspecting her boyfriend was cheating.
d46558a6720a.t: “Apa lagi?” Suara Eori terdengar feminin, tetapi nada menyelidiknya terdengar seperti gadis yandere yang curiga pacarnya selingkuh.

d46cad53c728.en: Without a flinch, Harry felt one of Eori’s hands move towards his throat while the other did something he couldn’t see. “M—my head hurts—”
d46cad53c728.t: Tanpa tersentak, Harry merasakan salah satu tangan Eori bergerak ke tenggorokannya sementara tangan yang lain melakukan sesuatu yang tidak bisa ia lihat. “K—kepalaku sakit—”

d6af2777453d.en: Harry suddenly awakened to a tight grip around his neck. He inhaled air with a guttural sound, trying to fill his lungs.
d6af2777453d.t: Harry tiba-tiba terbangun karena cengkeraman erat di lehernya. Ia menghirup udara dengan bunyi parau, berusaha mengisi paru-parunya.

d80a6fd44633.en: Looking down, the same jolting feeling appeared as his brain tried to cope with an apparent dissonant reality; his torso was healed while his gut was sliced open vertically. His innards poked through the wound, curiously wanting to plop out. However, he only still felt his chest being itchy—it was like he was in VR watching somebody else’s body being messed with.
d80a6fd44633.t: Menunduk, perasaan tersentak yang sama muncul saat otaknya berusaha mengatasi kenyataan yang tampak tidak selaras; tubuhnya sudah sembuh sementara perutnya terbelah vertikal. Isi perutnya menyembul dari luka itu, dengan penasaran ingin jatuh keluar. Namun, ia masih hanya merasakan dadanya gatal—seperti sedang memakai VR menonton tubuh orang lain diutak-atik.

df9bde77c5ad.en: “SHUT UP!” Eori’s scream echoed in the room as she stomped towards a cabinet under the stairs, opening and taking out a crossbow.
df9bde77c5ad.t: “DIAM!” Teriakan Eori menggema di ruangan saat ia mengentak-entakkan kaki menuju lemari di bawah tangga, membukanya dan mengeluarkan busur silang.

e4a430899bbb.en: With his eyes still tightly shut and his head trying to disappear into his neck, Harry just responded with a dissonant hum—the winking butthole still corrupted his imagination.
e4a430899bbb.t: Dengan matanya masih terpejam rapat dan kepalanya berusaha menghilang ke dalam lehernya, Harry hanya menjawab dengan gumaman sumbang—lubang pantat yang mengedip itu masih merusak imajinasinya.

e4d4ffa68983.en: “You fucking mute or what? I don’t have all day!” Eori picked a dirty knife from the same table and pointed towards Harry.
e4d4ffa68983.t: “Kau bisu, bangsat, atau apa? Aku tidak punya waktu seharian!” Eori mengambil pisau kotor dari meja yang sama dan mengarahkannya ke Harry.

e6169c864fc7.en: Meanwhile, the cold liquid deposited deep inside him felt like it had sand on it, hurting his insides if he moved slightly, even if he was taking a deeper breath. Unlike that night, he didn’t feel his senses tingling. He didn’t seem to be feeling anything—at least not at first. Maybe, just maybe, there was something different—like that odd feeling where you don’t know if you are high or not right after inhaling something of dubious quality.
e6169c864fc7.t: Sementara itu, cairan dingin yang tersimpan jauh di dalam dirinya terasa seperti ada pasirnya, melukai bagian dalam tubuhnya kalau ia bergerak sedikit saja, bahkan kalau ia menarik napas lebih dalam. Tidak seperti malam itu, ia tidak merasakan indranya kesemutan. Ia tampaknya tidak merasakan apa-apa—setidaknya tidak pada awalnya. Mungkin, mungkin saja, ada sesuatu yang berbeda—seperti perasaan aneh di mana kamu tidak tahu apakah kamu teler atau tidak tepat setelah mengisap sesuatu yang kualitasnya meragukan.

e65cc39683da.en: He saw a clear vision of the enchanting crowd roaring as he tried to drive the knife into Maiara’s belly while his body barely held it together, only to see a flash of her legs coming rushing to his neck, sharply ending it all. “Before Maiara kicked me and—I died,” Harry spoke quietly as a sinking feeling came stronger in his chest.
e65cc39683da.t: Ia melihat bayangan jelas kerumunan yang memesona menderu saat ia mencoba menusukkan pisau ke perut Maiara sementara tubuhnya nyaris tidak bisa bertahan, hanya untuk melihat kilatan kakinya yang melesat ke lehernya, mengakhiri semuanya dengan tajam. “Sebelum Maiara menendangku dan—aku mati,” kata Harry pelan sementara perasaan tenggelam semakin kuat di dadanya.

e70e114fc6f6.en: “Try again!” Eori came closer, crossed her arms, tapping her feet, carefully watching over Harry. A slightly annoyed frown began turning into a suspicious squint, then a slightly vicious smile formed.
e70e114fc6f6.t: “Coba lagi!” Eori mendekat, menyilangkan tangannya, mengetuk-ngetukkan kakinya, dengan cermat mengawasi Harry. Kerutan dahi yang agak kesal mulai berubah menjadi sipitan mata yang curiga, lalu senyum yang agak keji terbentuk.

ea0f895730ca.en: Vol 2 Chapter III subchapter 6: the purple-haired woman touches the bloodied chest of the chained Harry with a glowing hand.
ea0f895730ca.t: Jilid 2 Bab III subbab 6: wanita berambut ungu menyentuh dada Harry yang dirantai dan berlumuran darah dengan tangan bercahaya.

eba92e46d64c.en: “Argh—why the fuck didn’t Mom tell me I had to do all this shit too!” Eori kicked the barrel against the wall near the stairs, then proceeded to place a new empty barrel underneath the sink. “I’M SO FUCKING DONE!” She carefully washed her hand by sliding up the handle of a barrel above the sink—even cleaning in between the fingers and the wrist, too, like she were trying to avoid the plague or the next hot pandemic. Only a trickle of water came out from the handle rather than an angry gush. With sweat forming on her forehead, she gleaned back at Harry’s feeble gaze. “What the fuck do you want? I’m busy.”
eba92e46d64c.t: “Argh—kenapa Ibu tidak bilang padaku aku juga harus melakukan semua urusan sialan ini, bangsat!” Eori menendang tong itu ke dinding di dekat tangga, lalu menaruh tong kosong yang baru di bawah wastafel. “AKU MUAK SEKALI, BANGSAT!” Ia dengan hati-hati mencuci tangannya dengan menggeser ke atas tuas sebuah tong di atas wastafel—bahkan membersihkan sela-sela jari dan pergelangan tangannya juga, seolah sedang berusaha menghindari wabah atau pandemi besar berikutnya. Hanya tetesan air yang keluar dari tuas itu alih-alih semburan marah. Dengan keringat yang terbentuk di dahinya, ia melirik kembali ke tatapan Harry yang lemah. “Kau mau apa, bangsat? Aku sibuk.”

ee967e2c68fa.en: A silent Eori fed the spell using her other hand again, then released it into the bathtub, making the white flames clash and disappear into the back of her hand, coming out as water from her palm.
ee967e2c68fa.t: Eori yang diam mengumpankan mantra itu memakai tangannya yang lain lagi, lalu melepaskannya ke bak mandi, membuat api putih itu beradu dan menghilang ke punggung tangannya, keluar sebagai air dari telapak tangannya.

ef64a5cdaa6a.en: “Sorry—but I don’t—” The memory of that moment in the duel unlocked in his mind, growing vivid. Though exact details were vague, he could still hear the big metal-colored dice banging on the ground as the crowd eagerly awaited the results. “—something with white, blue—red too? Maiara did go on the first turn—I went on the second, before—”
ef64a5cdaa6a.t: “Maaf—tapi aku tidak—” Ingatan tentang momen di duel itu terbuka di benaknya, semakin jelas. Walaupun detail persisnya samar, ia masih bisa mendengar dadu besar berwarna logam itu berdentang di tanah sementara kerumunan menunggu hasilnya dengan penuh semangat. “—sesuatu dengan putih, biru—merah juga? Maiara memang dapat giliran pertama—aku di giliran kedua, sebelum—”

f1d119d0d6ac.en: “No, fuckwad!” Eori’s tone began to sound angrier as she finished corking three more nari gels. With the leftovers in the bowl not appearing enough to fill another nari gel, she grabbed a spoon and started scarfing it down into her mouth like a starving dog. Curling up her toes, she looked like she was holding her breath to swallow the whole thing down as quickly as possible. Banging the empty bowl back on the table, she wiped her mouth with a small towel. She then held herself on the table’s edge, grimacing towards Harry, her teeth dirty with red gel. She looked like she gagged, but it was probably a wet burp instead. She kept holding herself against the table as her body involuntarily twitched uncomfortably. A feminine grunt coming out of her began with her feminine voice but ended in a masculine voice, sounding pretty spot-on to Harry’s voice.
f1d119d0d6ac.t: “Bukan, goblok!” Nada Eori mulai terdengar lebih marah saat ia selesai menyumbat tiga nari gel lagi. Dengan sisa di mangkuk yang tampaknya tidak cukup untuk mengisi satu nari gel lagi, ia mengambil sendok dan mulai melahapnya ke mulutnya seperti anjing kelaparan. Menekuk jari-jari kakinya, ia tampak seperti menahan napas untuk menelan semuanya secepat mungkin. Membanting mangkuk kosong itu kembali ke meja, ia menyeka mulutnya dengan handuk kecil. Ia lalu berpegangan pada tepi meja, meringis ke arah Harry, giginya kotor oleh gel merah. Ia tampak seperti mual, tetapi mungkin itu sendawa basah. Ia terus berpegangan pada meja sementara tubuhnya berkedut tidak nyaman tanpa sadar. Erangan feminin yang keluar darinya dimulai dengan suara femininnya tetapi berakhir dengan suara maskulin, terdengar cukup persis seperti suara Harry.

f1e0b0df8fff.en: “Argh—we’re doing this again. What’s your name?” Eori, sounding like an interviewer, loosened her grip on Harry’s throat.
f1e0b0df8fff.t: “Argh—kita melakukan ini lagi. Siapa namamu?” Eori, terdengar seperti pewawancara, melonggarkan cengkeramannya di tenggorokan Harry.

f2af1cc663dd.en: Without saying a word, Harry opened his mouth and tilted his weighty head back like a baby bird in a nest. The blackish liquid tasted of black honey, mostly diluted in water. There were still clumps of it; some had to be pieces of honeycomb that nearly choked him as they slumped down his throat. The diabetic, nauseating taste was not there this time—maybe Eori had done something to it, or perhaps it was the only thing Harry had eaten or drunk in a while. “Thank—you—” The words quietly slumped out of his mouth.
f2af1cc663dd.t: Tanpa mengucapkan sepatah kata pun, Harry membuka mulutnya dan menengadahkan kepalanya yang berat ke belakang seperti anak burung di sarang. Cairan kehitaman itu rasanya seperti madu hitam, sebagian besar diencerkan dengan air. Masih ada gumpalan-gumpalannya; sebagian pasti potongan sarang lebah yang hampir membuatnya tersedak saat merosot turun di tenggorokannya. Rasa memuakkan yang bikin diabetes itu kali ini tidak ada—mungkin Eori melakukan sesuatu padanya, atau mungkin itu satu-satunya yang dimakan atau diminum Harry dalam waktu lama. “Terima—kasih—” Kata-kata itu merosot pelan dari mulutnya.

f412ac9b1432.en: “Don’t die on me yet.” Eori was washing her hands in the sink.
f412ac9b1432.t: “Jangan mati dulu.” Eori sedang mencuci tangannya di wastafel.

f482f9667ed4.en: “You’re not that much of a retard after all! Eiri, Sora, Aurora, and even Itagiba think you’re still out there, wasting the kingdom’s resources with the Sanbi-eye role. Meanwhile, I’m simply putting you to better use.” Eori went back to her clothing on the floor, bending forward to grab it, showing Harry a view of her, or rather his, butthole—looking like it was done on purpose.
f482f9667ed4.t: “Ternyata kau tidak seidiot itu! Eiri, Sora, Aurora, dan bahkan Itagiba mengira kau masih di luar sana, membuang-buang sumber daya kerajaan dengan peran Sanbi-eye. Sementara itu, aku sekadar memanfaatkanmu dengan lebih baik.” Eori kembali ke pakaiannya di lantai, membungkuk ke depan untuk mengambilnya, memperlihatkan kepada Harry pemandangan lubang pantatnya, atau lebih tepatnya lubang pantat si dia—tampak seperti disengaja.

f5e5b79a5dd1.en: Even though the knife was blurry in his eyes, he knew what it was and what would happen. However, the memory Eori just requested was kinda malformed in his brain. Even other memories were kinda in an odd state too, as if they were all behind closed doors, and he had to find them one by one—like that unknown weird feeling of self-discovery first thing in the morning, right after a night of heavy drinking where you don’t even know your name or where you are for a split second. With the anxious feeling inside him now frantically searching for his memories, pieces of his day began to surface again. “I-I—left Sanbi Castle with Sinoi?”
f5e5b79a5dd1.t: Walaupun pisau itu buram di matanya, ia tahu benda apa itu dan apa yang akan terjadi. Namun, ingatan yang baru saja diminta Eori agak cacat di otaknya. Bahkan ingatan-ingatan lain juga dalam keadaan agak aneh, seolah semuanya berada di balik pintu-pintu yang tertutup, dan ia harus menemukannya satu per satu—seperti perasaan aneh tak dikenal tentang menemukan diri sendiri di pagi hari, tepat setelah semalam minum berat ketika kamu bahkan tidak tahu namamu atau di mana kamu berada untuk sepersekian detik. Dengan perasaan cemas di dalam dirinya kini dengan panik mencari ingatannya, kepingan-kepingan harinya mulai muncul lagi. “A-aku—meninggalkan Kastil Sanbi bersama Sinoi?”

f65cbf05f4f3.en: Looking at it by accident, Harry’s mind went blank, and his face expressionless. He closed his eyes tightly, but the blurry image of his own butthole winking at him was burned in his retina and now in his memories.
f65cbf05f4f3.t: Memandangnya tanpa sengaja, pikiran Harry kosong, dan wajahnya tanpa ekspresi. Ia memejamkan matanya rapat-rapat, tetapi gambaran buram lubang pantatnya sendiri yang mengedip kepadanya sudah terbakar di retinanya dan kini di ingatannya.

f6839c67c525.en: “Before what?” Eori checked for split ends on her hair, taking glances at Harry.
f6839c67c525.t: “Sebelum apa?” Eori memeriksa ujung rambutnya yang bercabang, sambil melirik Harry.

f71076fa9210.en: “I-I—don’t think so.” Harry glanced back at Eori. Crossing gazes with her attentive pinkish eyes staring him down. Wait—did Eiri tell Eori everything too? So they were working together! Feeling a void filling in his heart, he opened his mouth to just spill everything out—like a dying corpse soiling itself, “I still have these feelings that some things just don’t feel normal—like I thought they would look different—like that sink. I don’t think I’ve ever seen barrels used like that.” Harry squinted, trying to capture additional details of the sink’s appearance. “I don’t feel like I belong here—I’m sorry, but I just want to go home.”
f71076fa9210.t: “A-aku—rasa tidak.” Harry kembali melirik Eori. Bertemu pandang dengan mata kemerahmudaannya yang penuh perhatian menatapnya tajam. Tunggu—apa Eiri juga menceritakan semuanya ke Eori? Jadi mereka bekerja sama! Merasakan kehampaan mengisi hatinya, ia membuka mulutnya untuk menumpahkan semuanya begitu saja—seperti mayat sekarat yang mengotori dirinya, “Aku masih punya perasaan bahwa beberapa hal terasa tidak normal—seperti kukira bentuknya akan berbeda—seperti wastafel itu. Kurasa aku belum pernah melihat tong dipakai seperti itu.” Harry menyipitkan matanya, mencoba menangkap detail tambahan tentang penampilan wastafel itu. “Aku merasa tidak berasal dari sini—maaf, tapi aku cuma mau pulang.”

f9556fbfc3b7.en: Harry felt a jolt of energy coursing his insides, seeing the vicious grin forming on Eori as she grabbed the jars by her and walked to the macabre corner to store them away. The sinking feeling became a subdued terror as he saw Eori grab what appeared to be a short blade on her way back. His innards told him to run away, but his numbed hands, limping feet, and tired mind didn’t seem to want to partake in that rodeo of trying to escape again. “Please—can you not make it hurt so much?” He blurted out quietly.
f9556fbfc3b7.t: Harry merasakan sentakan energi mengalir di bagian dalam tubuhnya, melihat seringai keji terbentuk di wajah Eori saat ia mengambil toples-toples di sampingnya dan berjalan ke sudut yang mengerikan untuk menyimpannya. Perasaan tenggelam itu menjadi teror yang teredam saat ia melihat Eori mengambil sesuatu yang tampak seperti bilah pendek dalam perjalanannya kembali. Bagian dalam dirinya menyuruhnya lari, tetapi tangannya yang mati rasa, kakinya yang terkulai, dan pikirannya yang lelah tampaknya tidak mau ikut serta dalam rodeo mencoba kabur lagi. “Tolong—bisakah tidak dibuat terlalu sakit?” semburnya pelan.

f9e7a11a0b6e.en: A significant shadow passed by, blocking the sun. Looking at it, Harry saw a big-ass bird gliding up high. Its blurry shape looked like a plane flying up high, but it was going too slow for it; plus the shape was not quite right. There are no plane trails at all—Harry felt that the sky was missing something he was accustomed to. Yeah—there’s supposed to be at least a few. A sinking feeling began emerging inside him. Maybe Tolerideme has them? But how do I even go there? Looking at the apparent endless forest, he sighed as he felt an itch coming from his chained wrists. I guess it doesn’t matter even if I find out where I am. I can’t remember my parents’ faces, let alone anybody else’s. But what if they recognize me instead? But how would I know?
f9e7a11a0b6e.t: Sebuah bayangan besar lewat, menghalangi matahari. Memandangnya, Harry melihat seekor burung besar banget yang melayang tinggi. Bentuknya yang buram tampak seperti pesawat yang terbang tinggi, tetapi geraknya terlalu lambat untuk sebuah pesawat; ditambah bentuknya tidak benar. Sama sekali tidak ada jejak pesawat—Harry merasa langit kehilangan sesuatu yang biasa ia lihat. Iya—seharusnya ada setidaknya beberapa. Perasaan tenggelam mulai muncul di dalam dirinya. Mungkin di Tolerideme ada? Tapi bagaimana caranya aku bisa ke sana? Memandang hutan yang tampaknya tak berujung, ia menghela napas sambil merasakan gatal dari pergelangan tangannya yang dirantai. Kurasa tidak penting juga kalau aku tahu di mana aku berada. Aku tidak ingat wajah orang tuaku, apalagi wajah orang lain. Tapi bagaimana kalau mereka yang mengenaliku? Tapi bagaimana aku bisa tahu?

fb5d45bcad9b.en: Harry froze in space and time—at least, that’s what it felt like. His mind was still full of thoughts, sensations, and worries, but he couldn’t process them. It felt like he had taken a massive hit from a dank bog, getting so unbelievably baked from the real sticky-icky-icky that his mind could only say Bruh.
fb5d45bcad9b.t: Harry membeku dalam ruang dan waktu—setidaknya, begitulah rasanya. Pikirannya masih penuh dengan pikiran, sensasi, dan kekhawatiran, tetapi ia tidak bisa memprosesnya. Rasanya seolah ia baru saja mengisap bong yang mantap dalam-dalam, teler berat luar biasa oleh barang sticky-icky-icky asli sampai pikirannya hanya bisa berkata Anjir.

fc574cf0b936.en: Nari gel? An agonizing pain struck Harry, seeing a scoop-sized chunk of meat and skin being flayed off his left triceps. Blood pooled from the wound and dripped down his armpit. In his mind, he saw Eori bursting into anger, making it far more painful if he fought back. “ARGH!” He contained the scream that slipped out his mouth to a loud grunt escaping his nose. He clenched his jaw tightly, nearly breaking his own teeth.
fc574cf0b936.t: Nari gel? Rasa sakit yang menyiksa menghantam Harry, melihat sepotong daging dan kulit seukuran satu sendok dikuliti dari trisep kirinya. Darah menggenang dari luka itu dan menetes ke ketiaknya. Di benaknya, ia melihat Eori meledak marah, membuatnya jauh lebih menyakitkan kalau ia melawan. “ARGH!” Ia menahan teriakan yang lolos dari mulutnya menjadi dengusan keras yang keluar dari hidungnya. Ia mengatupkan rahangnya erat-erat, hampir mematahkan giginya sendiri.
